description: Fetch your grade breakdown for a specific course or all enrolled courses in D2L Brightspace. Shows grade items (grade columns) with points, percentages, and comments. Use this when the user asks about grades, grade items, grade item, scores, marks, GPA, academic performance, or how they're doing in a class in Brightspace or D2L. Example: "What's my current grade in Calculus?"

courseId.description: Course ID to get grades for. If omitted, returns grades for all enrolled courses.

name: get_my_grades
title: Get My Grades
